_note: MOR spec pitch: single source of truth for picture and sound (read by the page and by audio.py). Seconds. 90 BPM, 1 beat = 0.6667 s = 20 frames @30 fps. The music's bar 1 starts on the push-through at 1.6 s (frame 48), so every cut sits on frame 48 + 20n (S5/S6 sit on half-beats). 'footage' = the edit list baked by tools/conform.py into 30 fps JPEG sequences in src/footage/<seg>/.

footage._note: keys: [[edit_t, source_s], ...]; source clips are 24 fps, 121 frames (5.04 s). Linear between two keys. mode blend = linear blend of the two nearest source frames (all MOR shots are slow camera moves). Cuts sit on whole frames.
